actions.title: Operational follow-up
actions.subtitle: Work that must carry into the next service, with a responsible person and a verified result.
actions.help: Choose an action, follow its instructions and submit what you did. A manager above you checks the result. For urgent help during service, use Request.
actions.newBody: Choose one responsible person below you in the reporting chain. Explain the result needed in both languages and set a realistic deadline.
actions.emptyBody: Assigned work appears here and stays until a superior verifies it or cancels it with a reason.
actions.noVenueBody: Ask management to assign an active venue before continuing.
actions.noPeople: No eligible people on this page. Load more or ask a superior to check venue assignments.
actions.dueHelp: All dates and times use New York. Choose a future time within one year.
actions.invalid: Complete both instructions, choose a person and check the future New York deadline.
actions.sourceHelp: This is a copy of the submitted close item. The original report stays unchanged.
actions.sourceInvalid: This close item is unavailable. Return to the close report and choose an item again.
actions.evidenceHelp: Describe the work and the result your manager can check. Avoid guest contact details and sensitive employee information.
actions.observationHelp: Record what you checked, what still needs work, or why the assignment must change.
actions.required: Write a concrete explanation of at least five characters.
actions.lockedBody: The assignment and evidence remain available for review. Closed records cannot be changed.
actions.wait: Your result is waiting for a manager's review. You do not need to submit it again.
actions.managerHelp: Read the submitted evidence before verifying. Return it with a concrete instruction if more work is needed.
actions.stale: Someone changed this action. Review the latest state before trying again.
